acceptanceCriteria: A documented flow runs a wave of at least three agents from the task store with disjoint leases on the Corvint repository.
An Edit on a path leased by another agent yields an advisory warning in a fixture test and never a deny.
The recorded run reports the merge conflicts between wave branches, compared against an unplanned wave.
body: Filed 2026-09-27 from the owner's request to research Corvint integrations with large productivity gains. `corvint work propose-wave` groups work by footprint and `corvint lease` records path leases (`internal/scopelease` enforces nothing). Proposal: a host-facing flow that takes the `.taskman` queue, proposes a wave whose impact footprints are disjoint, hands each item to a worktree agent with a held lease, and warns through PreToolUse Edit `additionalContext` when an agent edits a path another agent leased. Warnings only; no block, and lease state stays out of ranking, evidence and authority. Any productivity gain is a hypothesis until measured; `corvint surprise` and `corvint necessity` supply the measure.
title: work: overlap-free parallel agent waves from `propose-wave` plus scope leases
